ambiguities.fragment: between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic
ambiguities.explanation: The preposition 'between' can imply either that the routing switches filter network traffic exclusively between data-plane interfaces (excluding other types of interfaces) or that they filter both data-plane and management data traffic, but only the traffic flowing between these two types of interfaces.
possible_interpretations: The routing switches filter network traffic exclusively between data-plane interfaces.
The routing switches filter both data-plane and management data traffic, but only the traffic flowing between these two types of interfaces.
